paper.title: Materiality memo
paper.objective: Set overall materiality, performance materiality and the clearly trivial threshold for the FY2025-26 audit.
paper.procedure: Benchmark chosen from the Financial Spine's locked version; band applied per the firm's methodology; figures read from the Spine, not retyped.
paper.result: Benchmark revenue from operations 9,800,000.00 (PL.R.1). Overall materiality 490,000.00; performance materiality 250,000.00; clearly trivial 24,500.00.
paper.conclusion: Materiality set as above; to be revisited if the benchmark moves by more than 10% before the report is dated.
